name: RenewSys India Pvt. Ltd.
industry: Solar Energy Manufacturing and Supply Chain
summary: RenewSys commits to building a sustainable, low-carbon supply chain by working with suppliers that follow environmentally responsible, ethical, and socially fair practices. The policy emphasizes reducing carbon emissions, improving resource efficiency, and strengthening labor and human rights standards across procurement and supplier relationships.
tagline: Sustainable sourcing for a low-carbon future.

company.name: RenewSys India Pvt. Ltd.
company.address: Unit No 607, 6th Floor, Trade Centre, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East- 400051 Mumbai, Maharashtra India

declaration.preface: RenewSys India Pvt. Ltd. is committed to promoting sustainability across its supply chain as part of its broader corporate sustainability objectives. The Company seeks to integrate environmentally responsible and socially ethical practices into all aspects of procurement and supply chain management.
declaration.declaration: We pledge to work with suppliers who share our commitment to sustainability, ensuring that our products are sourced, produced, and delivered with minimal environmental impact and in accordance with the highest standards of ethical labor practices. This policy is guided by our responsibility to reduce our carbon footprint, support human rights, and foster fair labor conditions across the supply chain.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to all sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders.

focusAreas: Labor rights, human rights, and worker welfare

Environmental Responsibility Across the: Encourage suppliers to adopt sustainable practices and reduce environmental impact
Support responsible resource use and eco-friendly sourcing
Supplier Social Responsibility and Ethic: Respect human rights and fair labor practices across supplier relationships
Ensure suppliers sign and adhere to the Supplier Code of Conduct
Promote workforce development, inclusion, diversity, and worker well-being
Supplier Engagement and Capability Build: Strengthen ESG awareness and competence among suppliers and procurement teams
Conduct supplier capacity-building and collaboration initiatives
Use supplier self-assessment, audits, and remediation to drive continuous improvement

targets.target: Ensure 100% of all suppliers are aware of Renewsys’s environmental practices and are taking steps to reduce their carbon footprint and adopt responsible resource use
Achieve 90% supplier compliance with labor and human rights standards, verified through annual audits
Ensure 100% suppliers sign and adhere to a Supplier Code of Conduct
Reduce the overall carbon footprint of the supply chain by 25% through energy efficiency improvements and low-impact transportation methods
Source 10% of raw materials from local suppliers to reduce transportation-related emissions
Increase the proportion of local and diverse suppliers in the supply chain by 10%
Ensure 50% of suppliers implement one worker welfare or social improvement initiative
Conduct two supplier capacity-building or collaboration initiatives per year focused on ESG improvement areas

responsibilities.duty: Collect, compile, and prepare the Annual Green Supply Chain performance report.
Provide information on supplier audits and compliance data.
Track progress on eco-friendly initiatives and labor rights monitoring.
Review the policy annually and incorporate feedback from audits, employee input, and external assessments.

policy.monitoring: Progress is reported through an Annual Green Supply Chain performance report highlighting KPIs related to environmental and labor practices. Monitoring includes supplier adherence to environmental and human rights standards, progress toward sustainability targets, results of supplier audits and compliance checks, and initiatives to reduce carbon emissions and promote fair labor practices.
policy.reviewMechanism: The policy is reviewed annually by the Human Resources Manager. Feedback from supplier audits, employee input, and external assessments is incorporated into updates to ensure continuous improvement. The document also specifies a next review date of 03.04.27.
